title: Rights-Safe Semantic Presentation & Accessibility Projection

selection_basis.strict_order: GPR-01 → GPR-03 → GPR-05 → GPR-06 → GPR-07 → GPR-08 → GPR-09 → GPR-10 → GPR-12 → GPR-16
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MRCS is terminal completed_verified; OARC-07 remains independently selected_not_started.

objective: Bind authorized semantic actor/world/object/UI/effect/audio roles to runtime presentation with rights/use validation before production selection/export, and implement camera/HUD/menu/dialogue/reticle, semantic cue, accessibility and device projections without making presentation authoritative mechanics truth.
acceptance: Presentation bindings consume authorized semantic actor/world/object/UI/effect/audio role references and preserve their external canonical identities.
Rights/use eligibility is checked before production presentation selection, export or distributable projection; unresolved or disallowed rights fail closed.
Camera, HUD, menu, dialogue and reticle projections remain presentation-only and cannot mutate gameplay mechanics or owner truth.
Semantic visual/audio/effect cues project existing runtime meaning and do not become authoritative Action/Event or gameplay state.
Keyboard, touch, structured-text/list and screen-reader alternatives preserve essential semantic parity for supported interactions.
Device-specific projections preserve the same semantic state/outcome meaning and fail closed when a required capability has no supported accessible projection.
boundaries: GPR-01 through GPR-09 remain predecessors and are not duplicated.
ARI/PCA and other rights/provenance owners retain rights/use authority; GPR-10 consumes validated eligibility rather than creating a parallel rights ledger.
Presentation is never authoritative mechanics truth.
Audio content/runtime authority remains with its audio owners; GPR-10 binds semantic presentation roles only.
next_action: GPR-10 is completed_verified. GPR-12 — Multiplayer, Replay, Persistence, Recovery & Version Continuity — is selected_not_started and requires a later GPR-specific owner Continue for governed start.
